body.description: string — the note you will post, up to 4096 bytes.

rating.description: optional number — 1 to 5. Omit if the note is not a review.

salt.description: optional string — a number that makes this note distinct from an identical one; omitted, we pick.

subject.description: optional string — what the note is about. Lowercase, no spaces.

name: notes_sign

decimal string; BigInt does not survive JSON
